code-test-check v1.0.0 – Initial release

- Analyze user-specified backend and frontend source code against local PRD or functional test cases (Excel/JSON).
- Output a Markdown verification report containing code evidence and an implementation status matrix.
- Strict evidence-driven verification: every "implemented" status must include file path, line number, and code snippet.
- No assumptions: mark as "not found/not implemented" if evidence is lacking, regardless of common practices.
- Requires user confirmation of relevant source code directory paths and tech stack before analysis.
- Mandates associated impact analysis: trace code changes across shared assets to identify affected modules and regressions.
- Output report summarizes implementation status, key risks, associated impacts, and file path of the generated report.
